def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=g[0][0]
    segs=[]
    for r in range(H):
        c=0
        while c<W:
            if g[r][c]!=bg:
                v=g[r][c]; segs.append(v)
                while c<W and g[r][c]==v: c+=1
            else: c+=1
    # order: first appearance stable, group by value preserving first-appearance order
    order=[]
    for v in segs:
        if v not in order: order.append(v)
    out=[v for o in order for v in segs if v==o]
    cols=3; rows=(len(out)+cols-1)//cols
    out=out+[0]*(rows*cols-len(out))
    return [out[i*cols:(i+1)*cols] for i in range(rows)]
